objective: Evaluate the already-active submission on one fresh target-disjoint, language-shifted 800-case suite without using public outcomes for generation, thresholds, tuning, or reruns.

references.purpose: test the complete public-informed exact-evidence plus exposure stack

suite.target_selection: keyed deterministic selection without replacement, balanced as evenly as possible across three broad catalog families and within-family catalog-popularity thirds
suite.eligibility: catalog-valid products for which the official evaluator constructs a non-empty category and at least two distinct textual hard constraints
suite.scenario_and_surface_assignment: keyed deterministic shuffle independent of target attributes, with the official scenario mix reproduced inside each surface half
suite.profiles: neutral contract-valid profiles to avoid synthetic target-profile leakage
suite.hidden_fields: official evaluator intent_card, behavior, constraint classification, category, disclosure, override timing, normalization, hit eligibility, and metrics
suite.language_surface: 400 rows use the exact official evaluator surface so the active exposure path is exercised; 400 rows use a new fixed eight-template bank per semantic event to exercise conservative fail-open behavior; assignment is keyed and deterministic; semantic slots remain verbatim; no model or LLM generation

pre_execution_integrity: candidate, references, catalog, evaluator, API schema, generator, template bank, thresholds, and secret-seed commitment are hash locked
suite contains exactly 800 unique catalog-valid targets
suite target overlap with every historical exclusion is zero
suite scenario counts equal 320 buying, 320 browsing, 120 intent override, and 40 boundary
each surface contains 160 buying, 160 browsing, 60 intent override, and 20 boundary cases
selected and forbidden target sets are published only as keyed HMAC commitments
generator never imports or executes starter or conversational_search code
no candidate retrieval or ranking is used during selection or generation

decision_policy.pass: Retain the active candidate and describe it as fresh target- and language-shift-validated, while still not claiming mathematical certainty about the organizer distribution.
decision_policy.fail: Do not tune or rerun on the consumed suite. Mark the active candidate unvalidated and require a newly committed target-disjoint suite before any replacement is assessed.

limitations: The local catalog cannot prove that selected targets follow the organizer's private purchase distribution.
The official evaluator defines hidden-card semantics, so the suite is language-surface independent but not a wholly independent behavioral simulator.
Passing supplies strong finite-sample evidence, not a 100 percent proof over every possible hidden input.
